entries.notes: Point this at a real PSP .pmf movie asset. Add expect_video_codec_contains, expect_audio_codec_contains, expect_frame_size, or require_recovery when you want stricter packaged-runtime validation for native PSP video assets.
Point this at a real PS2 .pss sample. Add expect_video_codec_contains, expect_audio_codec_contains, min_frames, expect_frame_size, or require_recovery when you want stricter validation.
Point this at a real PlayStation .str sample. This is useful for validating legacy MPEG-style stream probing and any audio-drop or still-frame fallback behavior.
Use a real .vob sample here. Add require_recovery or expect_load_note_contains when you need to prove remux/transcode recovery stayed active.
Use a multipart VOB set like movie.vob.001 + movie.vob.002 to exercise concat repair. Add companions or keep all parts together in the same directory.
Optional real ASF sample for validating older index-heavy Windows media containers separately from WMV files.
Optional real WMV sample for validating packaged ffmpeg/ffprobe behavior on damaged-index or legacy Windows media assets.
Optional real MXF sample for validating editorial/multi-essence containers that may need remux/transcode recovery on fresh machines.
Use a real video file under an odd or unknown extension to validate ffprobe-based unknown-extension detection and recovery hints.
